fault_phase.outage_type: Simultaneous link-down on storage interface (nic3) across all 3 nodes
fault_phase.client_impact: All Ceph I/O blocked/frozen (expected safe behavior to prevent data corruption)

observations: Simultaneous nic3 shutdown isolated all Ceph storage traffic without affecting PVE management
During outage, client I/O paused safely; zero data lost, zero corruption
Upon bringing nic3 back UP, Ceph monitors re-established quorum almost immediately
All 12 OSDs rejoined within ~16s of link restoration
All 33 Placement Groups (PGs) peered and returned to active+clean
Cluster reached complete HEALTH_OK in 28 seconds from network restore
